title: Evidence route performance
description: provenance/route-performance.json in an evidence/v1 export (spec 1.1.0): the performance snapshots the router read, one canonical document for every execution/performance input the records of the chain name. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; the sha256 of the canonical form of each snapshot is a digest that some record names as an execution/performance input, each digest appears once, and every digest a record names appears; a figure has no more accepted outcomes than outcomes; at most 4096 snapshots and 256 candidates in each; executor and model are 1 to 256 bytes, task_class and language are 0 to 256 bytes, all of printable UTF-8 without leading or trailing space; the file is at most 1 MiB. The order of the snapshots (an exporter writes them by digest) and of the candidates (the policy order) is not checked.

export_version.description: The export layout version; 1 in evidence/v1.

snapshot.description: What the router read before it ranked one route: the figures of the strata of one task class and language, the position they were read at, the N they were counted against and the full list of candidates in policy order.

as_of.description: The position of the observations the figures fold.

n.description: The comparable outcomes a candidate needs before its figure may move it.

candidates.description: The whole list before ranking, in policy order, with the normalized ranks.

rank.description: Equal ranks are interchangeable candidates; the ranks do not decrease along the list.

figure.description: Absent when the snapshot holds no valid figure for the candidate.
